new_ops.name: softcapped_attention
new_ops.reason: Needs a GQA causal attention primitive that applies 50*tanh(s/50) to the [heads, T, T] pre-softmax logit matrix before the softmax. Its window must also switch between 4096-token sliding-window layers and global (8192) layers on alternating layers. The standard attention op exposes neither the logit cap nor a per-layer window schedule.
new_ops.quote: We cap logits~\citep{bello2016combinatorial} in each attention layer and the final layer such that the value of the logits stays between $-\text{soft\_cap}$ and $+\text{soft\_cap}$.

mechanisms_outside_ir.mechanism: Per-layer alternation of local sliding-window (4096) and global (8192 span) attention. The block is not identical across layers. Which parity starts with local attention is not stated.
mechanisms_outside_ir.quote: We alternate between a local sliding window attention~\citep{slidingwindow, beltagy2020longformer} and global attention~\citep{globalattention} in every other layer.

output.notes: The block is described with 2B dimensions; 9B and 27B use the same structure with the sizes given in Table 1. The 2B and 9B models are trained by distillation and the 27B from scratch; this does not change the architecture. Feedforward dim is reported exactly as in Table 1 (18432 for 2B) and is used for both the gate and up projections; the paper does not say whether this counts the gate and up projections combined. q/k/v projection widths are not stated explicitly; they follow from heads x head size. Not stated, so left not_stated: norm eps, RoPE theta and pairing, attention scale, biases, any final norm before the head (omitted from the head), and any embedding scaling. Residual connections and causality are taken from the 'decoder-only transformer' statement. Table 1's 'Global att. span 8192' is the span of the non-windowed layers.
